notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33428669/b6b98adaf498ce97ed72c5fdf67da7a6162b1195.png[/img]

Hi everyone, [b]Dymchick1[/b] is here with great news! 

[h1]Official Soundtrack DLC is now available for purchase. [/h1]

This DLC contains the full versions of all the soundtracks from "MOMO.EXE" created for you by "myuu". You can easily play it by Steam Music Player. You can also find the MP3 versions in your game folder.
